description: Mixes two signals against a common threshold: each output carries its own input's excursion above the threshold and is pushed down by how far the other input falls below it

params.text: Sets the threshold both inputs are measured against, from -10V to 10V

inputs.text: One of the two signals; what it has above the threshold goes to the first output and how far it falls below the threshold is subtracted from the second output
One of the two signals; what it has above the threshold goes to the second output and how far it falls below the threshold is subtracted from the first output
Adds to the threshold, one volt of threshold per volt

outputs.text: The first input's excursion above the threshold, plus the threshold, less the second input's excursion below it
The second input's excursion above the threshold, plus the threshold, less the first input's excursion below it

notes: the two channels are not a stereo pair; each output is built from both inputs and the maker's own tooltips say so in capitals.
mono only: a polyphonic cable is read as its first channel and both outputs carry one channel.
the lamp flashes once a second while either output is patched; with neither patched the module stops and the lamp holds.
